name: Poly Network
summary: EthCrossChainManager accepted an attacker-selected destination and method string from an authenticated cross-chain message. The string f1121318093 produced the selector of EthCrossChainData.putCurEpochConPubKeyBytes(bytes), allowing the attacker to replace the keeper public key and authorize later withdrawals.
notes: This transaction deployed the direct EthCrossChainManager runtime containing the unrestricted destination and method-selector construction used by the selected transaction.

The approximately $611 million gross loss covers the Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon withdrawals enabled by the keeper-key takeover. Poly Network reports more than $610 million stolen and Chainalysis reports $613 million across the three chains; $611 million preserves the contemporaneous incident estimate. The attacker later returned the assets, separately from exploit-time gross loss.
